text:
At 2:42 PM Central Standard Time, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over southern Wild Peach Village, or near West Columbia, moving east at 20 miles per hour. Hazard: Wind gusts up to 40 miles per hour and pea-sized hail. Source: Radar indicated.

Impact: Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is possible. Locations impacted include Lake Jackson, Angleton, Clute, West Columbia, Sweeny, Richwood, Brazoria, Jones Creek, Holiday Lakes, Bailey's Prairie, Bonney.

And Wild Peach Village.

Special Weather Statement issued November 15 at 2:43PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX.

At 2:42 PM Central Standard Time, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over southern Wild Peach Village, or near West Columbia, moving east at 20 miles per hour. Hazard: Wind gusts up to 40 miles per hour and pea-sized hail. Source: Radar indicated.

Impact: Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is possible. Locations impacted include Lake Jackson, Angleton, Clute, West Columbia, Sweeny, Richwood, Brazoria, Jones Creek, Holiday Lakes, Bailey's Prairie, Bonney.

And Wild Peach Village.
